title: Health check verifies DB reachability, not just process liveness
evidence: internal/api/api.go:81 health() calls store.Ping and returns 503 when the DB is unreachable (tested at internal/api/api_test.go:347 TestHealthReportsUnavailableDatabase)
suggestion: None — exceeds the R10 spec (a plain liveness endpoint would satisfy it).

title: Input hardening beyond the spec
evidence: internal/api/api.go:190 caps body at 1 MiB, rejects trailing JSON (api.go:204), and book.Validate (internal/book/book.go:54) enforces length limits, year range, and ISBN-10/13 shape
suggestion: None — R9 only requires title/author presence; these are extra robustness.

title: PUT uses documented full-replace semantics
evidence: internal/api/api.go:133 updateBook replaces all fields; omitted ISBN is cleared and a client-supplied id is ignored (test at internal/api/api_test.go:281)
suggestion: None — a valid interpretation of R5; noted so cross-run comparison can distinguish PUT vs PATCH behaviour.
